items.title: Nvidia earnings spark after-hours rally in chipmakers, neocloud stocks
items.summary: Investing.com-- Shares of chipmakers and cloud computing firms rose sharply in aftermarket trade on Tuesday after blowout quarterly earnings from sector giant Nvidia helped restore faith in the artificial intelligence trade.

items.title: Intel Stock Has Given Back About 60% Since June. Is It a Buy Now?
items.summary: The chipmaker expects its quarterly profit to drop by over half. How much of that does a $56 share price already reflect?

items.title: Nvidia, Other Chip Stocks Climb After Hours
items.summary: Nvidia and other chip stocks are up in afterhours trading after the scandal-rocked company beat estimates in its first earnings report since Jensen Huang’s ouster.

items.title: Earnings Boost Other Chip and AI Stocks
items.summary: Nvidia's peers, customers, and competitors got a lift from the chip maker's solid fiscal third-quarter earnings report, which indicated that demand for artificial-intelligence hardware is still strong.

items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway detailed Q3 buys and sells in a 13F filing late Monday. SpaceX stock popped.

items.title: Intel shareholders sue CEO, CFO after stock rout
items.summary: CEO Lip-Bu Tan and CFO David Zinsner failed to properly disclose the full impact of waning PC demand on company revenue and profitability for the PC maker, shareholders claim.
